items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public beta, full launch, and monetization. Keep SearchWoot private. Woot documentation confirms API access but not commercial/public display, caching, derivatives, alerts, affiliate use, or advertising rights; public terms point against those uses. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, attribution, privacy, and owner gates remain incomplete. Prepare an internal permission-request draft only; do not send it or alter the gate. Data-use decisions: Woot deal data=blocked pending written rights and field-level terms; user alerts=evidence_needed pending data-flow, retention, deletion, processor, consent, and unsubscribe evidence; GA4=evidence_needed pending deployed consent, property settings, retention, vendor disclosure, and jurisdiction review; operational logs/Cloudflare=evidence_needed pending log-field, retention/access, vendor/DPA, incident, and request procedures. No legal task is closed; four legal tasks remain open. Next evidence action: produce the internal Woot permission-request draft and read-only data-flow, consent/configuration, and vendor/log inventories for legal and owner review.

The private-preview gate remains unchanged. Ordinary report-only SEO evidence work may continue because incomplete telemetry is not itself a growth blocker; no public exposure, affiliate expansion, advertising, or new data collection is authorized.
